description: SYNTHORA email-posture: Email security posture of any domain, requirement by requirement: Google/Yahoo and Microsoft bulk-sender rules, PCI DSS 5.4.1 anti-phishing evidence and best practice (DMARC enforcement, SPF lookup count, DKIM across 54 selectors, MTA-STS policy and MX coverage, TLS-RPT, DNSSEC, DANE, BIMI). Returns a 0-100 grade, the exact DNS records to publish for each gap, a plain-language action plan drafted by our own model (marked as AI) and self-resolving calibration questions. Deterministic DNS over redundant DoH resolvers, Ed25519-signed, no charge on failure, no free tier. [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base]
